Signature.name: Clifton Thai Royal Platters(Price per person)
Signature.description: Special Chef’s selection of authentic Thai starters which comprise of golden spring rolls, sesame pork ribs, prawn tempura, Thai fish cakes and delicious chicken satay, served with various distinctive taste of sauces. (Minimum for 2 persons)

Signature.name: Butterfly King Prawn Tom Yum
Signature.description: Hot and sour soup flavour with chilli, lemongrass, coriander and giant size of King Prawn, served hot and fresh in clay pot. Chef said, “You won’t really know Thai food until you’ve tried this Tom Yum dish!” (Recommend for 2 people)

Signature.name: Thai Tamarind Sauce Duck
Signature.description: Duck, neatly marinated and fried before topping it up with distinctive style of juicy tamarind sauce and fried shallots, freshly served with crispy noodle underneath.

Signature.name: Pad Thai Goong Yai
Signature.description: Perfect match of finely selected Giant King Prawn with a famous ‘Pad Thai’ dish. It’s mouth-watering!
